ideas.pitch: A custom PyTorch architecture that explicitly injects the sun_azimuth_angle metadata as a geometric feature channel alongside grayscale pixel intensities to solve topographic inversion.
ideas.title: SunAngle-ResNet: Azimuth-Aware Lunar Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly attacks the core computer vision constraint of the challenge—topographic inversion caused by varying sunlight direction—by properly utilizing the provided metadata rather than training a naive baseline CNN.

ideas.pitch: A fine-tuned Vision Transformer (ViT) that maps 256x256 lunar tiles, using cross-attention mechanisms to correlate lighting angle metadata directly with patch embeddings.
ideas.title: TopoInvert-ViT: Vision Transformer for Lunar Surface Deception
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a genuinely hard engineering problem in computer vision by leveraging transformer cross-attention to dynamically adjust feature interpretation based on the sun_azimuth_angle.

ideas.pitch: An automated data augmentation script that synthetically rotates and re-lights training craters using 3D surface normal estimations to artificially expand the dataset and neutralize shadow bias.
ideas.title: LunarShadow-Augmentor: Synthetic Data Inversion Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages superior data engineering to overcome class confusion caused by lighting angles, giving the model a massive performance edge on hidden evaluation labels.

ideas.pitch: Transforms lunar grayscale images into connected topological graphs where nodes represent peaks and depressions, evaluating local neighborhood gradients against the sun azimuth angle.
ideas.title: CraterGNN: Graph Neural Network for Elevation Topological Mapping
ideas.why_it_could_win: Approaches crater vs. rise classification through structural graph connectivity rather than pure pixel mapping, uniquely handling ambiguous boundary formations.

ideas.pitch: An optimized blending framework combining lightweight EfficientNet, ResNet, and metadata Multi-Layer Perceptrons to maximize validation accuracy on the 2,000 evaluation images.
ideas.title: AstroVision-Ensemble: Multi-Model Stacking for Lunar Surface Classification
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on rigorous metric optimization and robust ensembling, which is historically the winning strategy for tabular-backed image classification challenges.
